name: emit-event
description: FEAT-20260602-005 helper. Publishes an arbitrary Cross event with the topic + payload supplied in function_params. Lets recovery pipelines synthesise the parent step's success event without a bespoke binary — the recovery is a one-step pipeline whose function_code is emit-event. The payload_match guard ensures this helper only activates when explicitly invoked by such a pipeline; plain work.pipeline.requested events go to start-pipeline as the default.
